name: agent-crabs
description: A pixel-art crab for every running subagent, dressed for its role, showing what it is working on.

outfits.title: Outfits
outfits.description: Comma-separated agent=outfit pairs, e.g. Olivia=beret,Simon=hardhat. Outfits: beret, hoodie, postman, grad, headset, magnifier, megaphone, hardhat, explorer, plain.

lingerSeconds.title: Linger (seconds)
lingerSeconds.description: How long a finished crab stays on screen before leaving. A failed one stays three times as long.

maxShown.title: Most crabs shown
maxShown.description: Crabs shown at once; the rest are counted as +N more.
